postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of people in each test case is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The sociability of each person is a non-negative integer up to 2 * 10^5.
There must be at least one valid output for each test case.
The output must correctly determine the maximum number of talks possible in a meeting, and list the pairs of people who will talk.
